name: statorc
description: Stator — an ahead-of-time compiler from TypeScript/JavaScript to native binaries

scripts.test:asan: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 make -C runtime asan && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 make -C runtime test-asan && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 STATOR_RUNTIME=asan node tests/golden/run.ts
scripts.test:intl: make -C runtime intl && STATOR_RUNTIME=intl node tests/golden/run.ts
scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run dupes && pnpm run runtime && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:subset && pnpm run test:golden && pnpm run test:builtins && pnpm run test:leak && pnpm run test:asan
